objective: Evaluate toolbelt v2, the harness repair driven by the v1 smoke evidence: layered submission, scope-aware verification against the deterministic width-split, page-first reading with crops reserved for flagged columns, and a staged independent second-reader channel per column.
hypothesis: Layered page-first reading with second-reader verification beats the image-only baseline's paired character error on the smoke set where v1 lost it, keeps invented characters at or below v1's levels, and preserves zero repetition; on passing, the full 28 confirms the win on both protected scope slices.
harness_changes_from_v1: submission is layered: {primary, commentary}; suite scoring reads primary, matching the measured best single scope policy (layered macro 0.385179 versus full-page 0.443086)
verify_layers checks primary text against primary-layer box counts only, from the same optimal width two-split validated in scope_layers
task and skill order the page image first; column crops are verification evidence for flagged columns only, repairing the measured crop-first regression on ordinary pages

every column carries an independent second reading staged at detection time (gemini-3.6-flash, minimal thinking, count-anchored ceiling min(2560, max(1024, 8n+64)) — the exact identity that ran 565 columns with zero truncation), and verify_layers reports columns whose second reading is absent from the draft

challenger.identity_note: distinct seed bytes so the candidate id cannot collide with the v1 challenger

implementation.detector: unchanged v1 pins: checkpoint cdc06d36, tile 512, overlap 96, threshold 0.31, nms 0.4, one-shot align_rfdetr_runtime
implementation.second_reader_cost_note: staging pays roughly 0.002 USD per column through the direct Gemini API; a 25-column page adds about 0.05 USD to the challenger side

execution.policy: Smoke first; start the full 28 only if all four challenger sessions seal, the paired smoke mean favors the challenger, and smoke spend stays at or below 4 USD.

gates.smoke_finished_outputs: 4 of 4 challenger sessions sealed with layered artifacts
gates.smoke_quality: paired smoke mean character_error_rate favors the challenger
gates.smoke_budget: smoke spend at or below 4 USD
gates.full_quality: challenger mean character_error_rate below the baseline's, and no protected scope slice regresses beyond the suite policy
gates.full_hard_limits: all four suite limits pass on the challenger
gates.budget_stop: bench run --max-cost aborts dispatch at the ceiling

allowed_changes: library/evaluations/runs (run records produced by bench run)
non_goals: Do not touch AncientDoc qualification-reserve books.
Do not run bench propose or promote.
Do not modify the exodia campaign loop or partition.
next_permitted_action: Run the four-case smoke under the smoke budget, evaluate the smoke gates, then run the full 28 only if every smoke gate passes.
